/* selectMasterMpSoGrDetailList */
SELECT G.BUYER, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = G.BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME, G.GR_NO, G.GR_SEQ, D.PO_NO, D.PO_SEQ, D.LEGACY_PO_NO, D.LEGACY_PO_SEQ, G.AGENT, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = G.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME, G.BUYER_ITEM_NO, D.REF_PR_NO, H.PO_CREATE_DATE, G.GR_DATE, D.DESCRIPTION, D.SPECIFICATION, D.MAKER_CODE, D.MAKER_NAME, D.UNIT_MEASURE, D.ORIGIN_CODE, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M001' AND CODE = D.ORIGIN_CODE) AS ORIGIN_NAME, R.MAKER_PART_NO, D.ITEM_QTY AS PO_QTY, G.ITEM_QTY AS GR_QTY, D.UNIT_PRICE, D.UNIT_PRICE * D.ITEM_QTY AS UNIT_SUM, D.AGENT_PRICE, D.AGENT_PRICE * D.ITEM_QTY AS AGENT_SUM, R.PURCHASER_DEPT, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C001' AND COMPANY_CODE = R.BUYER AND CODE = R.PURCHASER_DEPT) AS PURCHASER_DEPT_NAME, H.PURCHASER_ID, H.PURCHASER_NAME, R.REQ_DEPT, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C001' AND COMPANY_CODE = R.BUYER AND CODE = R.REQ_DEPT) AS REQ_DEPT_NAME, R.REQ_USER_ID, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE COM_CODE = R.BUYER AND USER_ID = R.REQ_USER_ID) AS REQ_USER_NAME, G.INV_NO, G.INV_SEQ, G.GR_CREATOR_NAME, G.GR_CREATOR_EMAIL, D.PROCESS_TYPE, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M034' AND CODE = D.PROCESS_TYPE) AS PROCESS_TYPE_NAME, NVL(G.LOGIS_RATE, F_GET_LOGISTICS_FEE_INFO(D.BUYER, D.BUYER_ITEM_NO, D.PROCESS_TYPE, H.AGENT, 0, '02', D.WAREHOUSE_CODE)) AS LOGIS_RATE, (SELECT CODE || ':' || TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'LGST' AND CODE = NVL(G.LOGIS_RATE_STATUS, F_GET_LOGISTICS_FEE_INFO(D.BUYER, D.BUYER_ITEM_NO, D.PROCESS_TYPE, H.AGENT, 0,'03', D.WAREHOUSE_CODE))) AS LOGIS_RATE_STATUS, G.AR_TAX_BILL_NO, G.AR_BILL_FLAG, G.AP_TAX_BILL_NO, G.AP_BILL_FLAG, R.PR_NO, R.PR_SEQ, CASE WHEN D.PROCESS_TYPE = '0' THEN (SELECT IVHD.IMAGE_KEY_INV FROM ICOMIVHD IVHD WHERE IVHD.BUYER = G.BUYER AND IVHD.INV_NO = G.INV_NO AND IVHD.STATUS != 'D') ELSE (SELECT WMS.IMAGE_KEY_INV FROM WMSIVDT WMS WHERE WMS.BUYER = G.BUYER AND WMS.INV_NO = G.INV_NO AND WMS.INV_SEQ = G.INV_SEQ AND WMS.STATUS != 'D') END AS IMAGE_KEY_INV , CASE WHEN D.PROCESS_TYPE = '0' THEN (SELECT DECODE(IVHD.IMAGE_KEY_INV,'',2,3) FROM ICOMIVHD IVHD WHERE IVHD.BUYER = G.BUYER AND IVHD.INV_NO = G.INV_NO AND IVHD.STATUS != 'D') ELSE (SELECT DECODE(WMS.IMAGE_KEY_INV,'',2,3) FROM WMSIVDT WMS WHERE WMS.BUYER = G.BUYER AND WMS.INV_NO = G.INV_NO AND WMS.INV_SEQ = G.INV_SEQ AND WMS.STATUS != 'D') END AS IMAGE_KEY_INV_IMG, CASE WHEN D.PROCESS_TYPE = '0' THEN (SELECT IVHD.IMAGE_KEY_SIGN FROM ICOMIVHD IVHD WHERE IVHD.BUYER = G.BUYER AND IVHD.INV_NO = G.INV_NO AND IVHD.STATUS != 'D') ELSE (SELECT WMS.IMAGE_KEY_SIGN FROM WMSIVDT WMS WHERE WMS.BUYER = G.BUYER AND WMS.INV_NO = G.INV_NO AND WMS.INV_SEQ = G.INV_SEQ AND WMS.STATUS != 'D') END AS IMAGE_KEY_SIGN , CASE WHEN D.PROCESS_TYPE = '0' THEN (SELECT DECODE(IVHD.IMAGE_KEY_SIGN,'',2,3) FROM ICOMIVHD IVHD WHERE IVHD.BUYER = G.BUYER AND IVHD.INV_NO = G.INV_NO AND IVHD.STATUS != 'D') ELSE (SELECT DECODE(WMS.IMAGE_KEY_SIGN,'',2,3) FROM WMSIVDT WMS WHERE WMS.BUYER = G.BUYER AND WMS.INV_NO = G.INV_NO AND WMS.INV_SEQ = G.INV_SEQ AND WMS.STATUS != 'D') END AS IMAGE_KEY_SIGN_IMG, CASE WHEN D.PROCESS_TYPE = '0' THEN (SELECT F_GET_CMCD_NAME('C019', IVHD.PARCEL_COM_CODE)||' '||IVHD.PARCEL_INV_NO FROM ICOMIVHD IVHD WHERE IVHD.BUYER = G.BUYER AND IVHD.INV_NO = G.INV_NO AND IVHD.STATUS != 'D') ELSE (SELECT F_GET_CMCD_NAME('C019', WMS.DELIVERY_COMPANY)||' '||WMS.DELIVERY_NO FROM WMSIVDT WMS WHERE WMS.BUYER = G.BUYER AND WMS.INV_NO = G.INV_NO AND WMS.INV_SEQ = G.INV_SEQ AND WMS.STATUS != 'D') END AS PARCEL_INFO , NVL(BUYER.AUTO_GR_FLAG, 'N') AS AUTO_GR_FLAG, R.BUDGET_DEPT, R.ACCOUNT_TYPE, H.PO_REMARK AS PO_REMARK_HD, G.LEGACY_GR_NO, (SELECT DECODE(COUNT(*),0,'N','Y') FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'W001' AND TEXT1 = G.BUYER) AS WAREHOUSE_BUYER_YN FROM ICOMPODT D, ICOMGRDT G, ICOMPOHD H, ICOMPRDT R, KEP_BUYER_FLAG BUYER WHERE 1=1 AND D.BUYER = G.BUYER AND D.PO_NO = G.PO_NO AND D.PO_SEQ = G.PO_SEQ AND D.BUYER = H.BUYER AND D.PO_NO = H.PO_NO AND D.BUYER = R.BUYER AND D.PR_NO = R.PR_NO AND D.PR_SEQ = R.PR_SEQ AND R.BUYER = BUYER.COM_CODE(+) AND D.STATUS <> 'D' AND G.STATUS <> 'D' AND H.STATUS <> 'D' AND R.STATUS <> 'D'
AND G.BUYER IN
#{status}
AND G.GR_DATE
AND H.PO_CREATE_DATE
BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND H.AGENT =#{st_agent_code}
AND H.PO_NO LIKE UPPER('%'|| #{st_search_po_no} ||'%')
AND G.GR_NO LIKE UPPER('%'|| #{st_search_gr_no} ||'%')
AND D.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE UPPER('%'|| #{st_search_buyer_item_no} ||'%')
AND R.BUDGET_DEPT LIKE UPPER('%'|| #{st_budget_dept} ||'%')
AND (D.DESCRIPTION LIKE '%'|| #{st_search_desc_spec} || '%' OR D.SPECIFICATION LIKE '%'|| #{st_search_desc_spec} || '%' )
AND G.AR_BILL_FLAG = 'N'
ORDER BY D.BUYER, D.PO_NO, D.PO_SEQ

D.BUYER_ITEM_NO, D.PROCESS_TYPE, H.AGENT, 0,'03', D.WAREHOUSE_CODE))) AS LOGIS_RATE_STATUS, G.AR_TAX_BILL_NO, G.AR_BILL_FLAG, R.PR_NO, R.PR_SEQ, CASE WHEN D.PROCESS_TYPE = '0' THEN (SELECT IVHD.IMAGE_KEY_INV FROM ICOMIVHD IVHD WHERE IVHD.BUYER = G.BUYER AND IVHD.INV_NO = G.INV_NO AND IVHD.STATUS != 'D') ELSE (SELECT WMS.IMAGE_KEY_INV FROM WMSIVDT WMS WHERE WMS.BUYER = G.BUYER AND WMS.INV_NO = G.INV_NO AND WMS.INV_SEQ = G.INV_SEQ AND WMS.STATUS != 'D') END AS IMAGE_KEY_INV , CASE WHEN D.PROCESS_TYPE = '0' THEN (SELECT DECODE(IVHD.IMAGE_KEY_INV,'',2,3) FROM ICOMIVHD IVHD WHERE IVHD.BUYER = G.BUYER AND IVHD.INV_NO = G.INV_NO AND IVHD.STATUS != 'D') ELSE (SELECT DECODE(WMS.IMAGE_KEY_INV,'',2,3) FROM WMSIVDT WMS WHERE WMS.BUYER = G.BUYER AND WMS.INV_NO = G.INV_NO AND WMS.INV_SEQ = G.INV_SEQ AND WMS.STATUS != 'D') END AS IMAGE_KEY_INV_IMG, CASE WHEN D.PROCESS_TYPE = '0' THEN (SELECT IVHD.IMAGE_KEY_SIGN FROM ICOMIVHD IVHD WHERE IVHD.BUYER = G.BUYER AND IVHD.INV_NO = G.INV_NO AND IVHD.STATUS != 'D') ELSE (SELECT WMS.IMAGE_KEY_SIGN FROM WMSIVDT WMS WHERE WMS.BUYER = G.BUYER AND WMS.INV_NO = G.INV_NO AND WMS.INV_SEQ = G.INV_SEQ AND WMS.STATUS != 'D') END AS IMAGE_KEY_SIGN , CASE WHEN D.PROCESS_TYPE = '0' THEN (SELECT DECODE(IVHD.IMAGE_KEY_SIGN,'',2,3) FROM ICOMIVHD IVHD WHERE IVHD.BUYER = G.BUYER AND IVHD.INV_NO = G.INV_NO AND IVHD.STATUS != 'D') ELSE (SELECT DECODE(WMS.IMAGE_KEY_SIGN,'',2,3) FROM WMSIVDT WMS WHERE WMS.BUYER = G.BUYER AND WMS.INV_NO = G.INV_NO AND WMS.INV_SEQ = G.INV_SEQ AND WMS.STATUS != 'D') END AS IMAGE_KEY_SIGN_IMG, CASE WHEN 'D') ELSE (SELECT F_GET_CMCD_NAME('C019', WMS.DELIVERY_COMPANY)||' '||WMS.DELIVERY_NO FROM WMSIVDT WMS WHERE WMS.BUYER = G.BUYER AND WMS.INV_NO = G.INV_NO AND WMS.INV_SEQ = G.INV_SEQ AND WMS.STATUS != 'D') END AS PARCEL_INFO , NVL(BUYER.AUTO_GR_FLAG, 'N') AS AUTO_GR_FLAG, R.BUDGET_DEPT, R.ACCOUNT_TYPE, H.PO_REMARK AS PO_REMARK_HD, G.LEGACY_GR_NO, (SELECT DECODE(COUNT(*),0,'N','Y') FROM ICOMCOD1 AND IVDT.INV_SEQ = G.INV_SEQ AND IVDT.STATUS != 'D') ELSE (SELECT IVDT.DELIVERY_DATE FROM ICOMIVDT IVDT WHERE (IVDT.BUYER,IVDT.INV_NO,IVDT.INV_SEQ) = (SELECT WMS.BUYER,WMS.S_INV_NO,WMS.S_INV_SEQ FROM SELECT HD.PROCESS_TYPE,WMS.WAREHOUSE_CODE FROM ICOMPODT PO, ICOMPOHD HD, WMSIVDT WMS WHERE PO.BUYER = #{BUYER} AND PO.PO_NO=#{PO_NO} AND PO.PO_SEQ = #{PO_SEQ} AND PO.BUYER = HD.BUYER AND PO.PO_NO = HD.PO_NO AND PO.BUYER = WMS.BUYER(+) AND PO.PO_NO = WMS.PO_NO(+) AND PO.PO_SEQ = WMS.PO_SEQ(+) AND WMS.STATUS(+) <> 'D' AND PO.STATUS <> 'D' AND HD.STATUS <> 'D'
mapper.update: /*setNewGrDel_Item2*/ UPDATE WMSIVDT A SET A.BUYER_GR_QTY = 0, A.CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), A.CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE (A.BUYER, A.INV_NO, A.INV_SEQ) IN (SELECT BUYER, INV_NO, INV_SEQ FROM ICOMGRDT WHERE BUYER = #{BUYER} AND GR_NO = #{GR_NO} AND GR_SEQ = #{GR_SEQ}) AND A.SELLER = 'KRKORE0001' AND A.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{WAREHOUSE_CODE} AND A.STATUS <> 'D'

/* setNewGrDel_Item5 */ UPDATE ICOMIVDT A SET A.GR_QTY = 0, A.CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), A.CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE (A.BUYER, A.INV_NO, A.INV_SEQ) IN (SELECT BUYER, INV_NO, INV_SEQ FROM ICOMGRDT WHERE BUYER = #{BUYER} AND GR_NO = #{GR_NO} AND GR_SEQ = #{GR_SEQ}) AND A.SELLER = 'KRKORE0001' AND A.STATUS <> 'D'
